image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a white ceramic bowl containing three scoops of ice cream. The central scoop is predominantly white with pink swirls and dark speckles (possibly fruit or chocolate). The side scoops appear to be vanilla or light caramel with some browning/melting. The bowl sits on a wooden surface next to a patterned napkin or packaging. A spoon handle is visible in the upper right. The lighting is bright, casting soft shadows.
